svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 08 / TRAIN
svg.desc: 18,350 GitHub contributions across 155 active days, 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-31. A train follows the weeks chronologically, stopping only at stations with actual contributions. Landscape seasons follow calendar months in the northern hemisphere.
svg.text: A stop for every active week
